title: Tracking: Upstream dioxus-native blitz 0.3+ parity and migration path
symptoms: dioxus-native 0.7.10 on crates.io pins blitz-dom 0.2.4, conflicting with blitz-dom 0.3.0-beta.2 via stylo servo_style_crate link collision. Also does not inject BaseDocument into Dioxus root context.
cause: Upstream DioxusLabs has not published dioxus-native matching blitz-dom 0.3.0-beta.2 + dioxus 0.7.0 on crates.io, leaving a temporary published crate gap.
solution: Once upstream publishes dioxus-native with blitz >= 0.3 support: 1) Replace internal launch::native bridge with published dioxus-native. 2) Ensure Document::current() context injection remains unbroken. 3) Preserve #[oxidase::main], Document, and frame APIs without breaking consumer code. In the interim, maintain sovereign in-crate adapter with published blitz-dom 0.3.0-beta.2.
